entries.name: 신전기둥 해마
entries.description: 대리석 기둥처럼 홈이 파인 몸을 가진 해마. 가만히 서 있으면 유적 관람객이 사진을 찍어요.
entries.prompt: Four-frame 2x2 transparent game atlas of a right-facing cute ivory marble seahorse with Ionic column fluting, scroll capital crest and seafoam fins; warm brown outlines, soft storybook shading, stable body and gently moving fins/tail, generous cell margins.

entries.name: 동전비늘 붕어
entries.description: 낡은 청동 동전 같은 비늘이 반짝이는 붕어. 카론의 뱃삯으로 내밀었지만 승선은 거절당했어요.
entries.prompt: Four-frame 2x2 transparent game atlas of a right-facing cute bronze coin-scaled crucian carp, subtle Greek dolphin and olive reliefs, mint fins and cream belly; warm brown outlines, soft storybook shading, stable body and alternating tail bends, generous cell margins.

entries.name: 아리아드네 실꼬리
entries.description: 붉은 실 같은 꼬리로 돌아갈 길을 남기는 물고기. 미궁에서도 길을 찾지만 낚싯줄과 엉키면 잠깐 생각에 잠겨요.
entries.prompt: Four-frame 2x2 transparent game atlas of a right-facing cute pearl-ivory rose fish with Greek meander dorsal motif, long crimson thread tail and tiny gold spindle charm; warm brown outlines, soft storybook shading, stable body and gently waving thread/fins, entire tail inside generous cell margins.
